name: @tokenis/crypto
description: Tokenis cryptographic SDK for TypeScript/JavaScript: EC-ElGamal additive homomorphic encryption and no-key delegation, compiled from the same Rust core as the Python SDK

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/tokenis-wasm --release --target nodejs --weak-refs --out-dir ../../sdk/typescript/wasm --out-name tokenis_wasm --no-pack && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('wasm/package.json', JSON.stringify({type: 'commonjs'}) + '\n')"
